title: The 5 Best Massage Guns for Lower Back Pain
h1: The 5 Best Massage Guns for Lower Back Pain
metaDescription: Our 5 picks for massage guns for lower back pain, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at massage guns for lower back pain using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Opove M3 Pro 2 Massage Gun
products.blurb: Key specs: 12mm amplitude, 70 lbs stall force, 4 to 8 hour battery life.
strengths: 70 lbs stall force is enough to work through dense lower-back and glute muscle without the motor bogging down
12mm amplitude reaches deeper into tight erector spinae muscles than shallower guns
Long battery life supports daily use for chronic tightness management
limitations: More intense feel at full power may be too much for sensitive lower backs, start on lower speeds
Heavier body can be tiring to hold at an angle for a long session

products.name: RENPHO Active Massage Gun
products.blurb: Key specs: 5 speed settings, 5 interchangeable heads, Carry case included.
strengths: 5 speed settings let you start gentle for a first-time or sensitive lower back and build up
Flat and fork-style heads included, better suited to muscles around the spine than pointed heads
Quiet enough for a short break at a desk without disturbing others nearby
limitations: Lower stall force than the Opove for very tight or dense lower-back muscle
Battery life shorter under heavy daily use

products.name: TOLOCO Massage Gun
products.blurb: Key specs: 10 massage heads, Silent brushless motor, Multiple speed levels.
strengths: Ten heads included gives plenty of options to find one comfortable on the lower back
Low price makes it easy to try percussion therapy before committing to a premium gun
limitations: Lower stall force struggles on very dense or chronically tight lower-back muscle
Auto shut-off at 10 minutes can interrupt a longer session

products.name: Bob and Brad C2 Massage Gun
limitations: Charger brick not included on some versions
Not as deep as pro guns

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
